name: Shen Chung-Ping
source: Shen has embarked on a journey to search for the truth behind his brother's death, which he believes to be murder. Unfortunately, the road ahead is full of difficulties and dangers as he is faced with various strange cases blocking his way. With his abilities and his wisdom, John is able to solve a number of bizarre cases through investigation and reasoning, becoming a traveling detective that roams the country.
